Artemis II launch location is Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II crew is Reid Wiseman, Christina Koch, Victor Glover, and Jeremy Hansen.
NASA has backup launch opportunities available through April 6, 2026, if needed.
